gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-multani: Tilt Neon draws every letter as a tube of constant width, loud and commanding. Noto Sans Multani keeps things modern and quiet, with a wide gap at the e terminal and a lofty lowercase.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-nag-mundar: Tilt Neon squeezes out its letters like toothpaste in one steady line, bold and commanding. Noto Sans Nag Mundari takes over with c and s shapes that look half unwrapped, and lowercase that rivals the capitals.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-newa: Tilt Neon gives its n arches the same heft as the stems beside them, a tube-like stroke that never thins. Noto Sans Newa reads easily, with an open-mouthed e and tall bowls.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-old-permic: Tilt Neon cuts each letter from ribbon of constant width, bold and commanding, with short ascenders. Noto Sans Old Permic is friendlier and contemporary, rounded and open to the side.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-old-sogdia: Noto Sans Old Sogdian reads clean and approachable, its wide-mouthed letters staying crisp when shrunk. Tilt Neon handles the shouting instead, its steady line weight never wavering from letter to letter.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-oriya: Tilt Neon keeps every letter to one tube-like stroke, bold and commanding, with short ascenders. Then Noto Sans Oriya brings generous gaps in its curves and small letters almost as tall as the capitals.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-pahawh-hmo: Tilt Neon holds its stroke width constant from the first letter to the last, bold and commanding in a tube-like line. Loud meets restrained as Noto Sans Pahawh Hmong gaps its rounds.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-phoenician: Tilt Neon builds bold, commanding letters on a wire-like monoline skeleton, with short ascenders. But Noto Sans Phoenician loosens things up, its s curves opening wide at both ends over a generous lowercase.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-sunuwar: Noto Sans Sunuwar leaves daylight in its curves, like a rope's open bight, with short ascender stems on tall lowercase bodies. Tilt Neon, cut from strips of equal width, supplies the bold punch.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-syloti-nag: Commanding and marker-like, Tilt Neon holds one steady line weight across every letter. Noto Sans Syloti Nagri brings a clean, professional counterweight, its a opening its lower bowl to breathe.
